sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consent c WHERE c.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND c.person_id = p.id AND c.channel = $3::text AND c.topic_id = $2::uuid AND c.status = $4::text) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consent c WHERE c.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND c.person_id = p.id AND c.channel = $3::text AND c.topic_id = $2::uuid AND c.status = $5::text) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consent c WHERE c.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND c.person_id = p.id AND c.channel = $3::text AND c.topic_id = $2::uuid AND c.status <> $6::text) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consent c WHERE c.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND c.person_id = p.id AND c.channel = $3::text AND c.topic_id IS NULL AND c.status <> $6::text) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consent c WHERE c.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND c.person_id = p.id AND c.channel = $3::text AND c.topic_id IS NULL AND c.status = $7::text)))
